title: Agent J card (card.json, schemaVersion 1 — phase 1: template cards)
description: One card in the phone's logo menu, from card 6 on. Checked by `agentj card validate` (this schema plus the rules it cannot say: reserved ids, credential-looking file names, prompt variables, folder contents). Spec: agentjarvis/docs/specs/AGENTJ-CARDS-SPEC.md.

id.description: permanent; agentj-*, official-*, the official and system card ids are reserved

icon.description: a built-in line icon (phase 1 takes no image files)

accent.description: the deck card's fill, from Leo's closed palette; no custom colours

file.description: one file name in <state>/agentperm/cards-data/<id>/; notes: .md / .txt, checklist: .json

get.description: P432, instead of file: GET http://127.0.0.1:<server.port><get> (needs server); no query, no ..

itemActions.description: checklist only: buttons on every item; also {{item.id}} {{item.text}} {{item.done}}

plus.description: the header's + on this card's page: one slash skill (no /) the phone puts in the message box, e.g. agentj-add-note; nothing is sent. Missing: agentj-cards

anchors.description: named places card/<id>#<anchor> scrolls to; every card also has top · actions · links, a checklist's item ids are anchors too

links.description: links on the card's page: href = a web page in a new tab (the phone shows the address first), jlink = an Agent J internal link

server.description: P432: the card's own server on this computer (the owner's Agent installs it). serve asks it on 127.0.0.1 only, sends and requires back X-AgentJ-Card: <id>, ≤ 5 s, bounded size and rate; the phone never reaches it

routes.description: POST routes a button may call (action.call); the host makes the body {card, action, item?, lang}

repo.description: where the server's source lives (a plaza card: required, with ref)

ref.description: the exact commit of repo (never a branch name)

heading.description: notes template only: the first Markdown heading with this text

href.description: http / https only; no user:password@, no token / key / secret / password / auth / session / signature parameter

jlink.description: skill/<name> · workflow/<folder> · doc/[<folder>/]<file>.md · card/<id>[#<anchor>] · page/<page> — opens inside Agent J

call.description: P432, instead of prompt: one id of server.routes — the phone shows where it goes and asks the card's server on the owner's tap

prompt.description: the chat message the button proposes (≤ 2000 characters); the phone shows it in full and sends only after the owner confirms

draft.description: true: the message goes into the message box for the owner to finish, nothing is sent
